'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[September 2024 Lebanon strikes]]
***The death toll from the ongoing [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s across [[Lebanon]] increases to 558 people, including 50 children, with 1,835 others injured. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/24/israel-attacks-lebanon-live-global-calls-for-restraint-as-492-killed (Al Jazeera)]
***The [[Israeli government]] declares a nationwide [[state of emergency]] until September 30. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/state-of-emergency-declared-in-israel-until-sept-30-amid-israeli-escalation-against-lebanon/3338855 (Anadolu Agency)]
***Ibrahim Qubaisi, [[Hezbollah]]'s missiles and rocket force commander, is killed after an [[airstrike]] in [[Beirut]], Lebanon. Five other people are also killed in the attack. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/sep/25/israel-lebanon-strikes-hezbollah-commander-ibrahim-qubaisi-latest-news-death-toll (''The Guardian'')]
***The [[United Kingdom]] deploys 700 [[British Armed Forces|troops]] to [[Cyprus]] ahead of a planned [[emergency evacuation|evacuation]] of thousands of British nationals from Lebanon. The UK has advised all of its citizens to leave Lebanon immediately if they can. [https://www.reuters.com/world/britain-urges-nationals-leave-lebanon-2024-09-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
***At least three people are killed and 22 others are injured in a [[Russia]]n [[guided bomb]] attack on an apartment building in [[Kharkiv]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-strikes-apartment-block-ukraines-kharkiv-least-5-injured-deaths-likely-2024-09-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mexican Drug War]]
**The death toll from the ongoing shootouts between rival factions of the [[Sinaloa Cartel]] increases to at least 77 people, with the finding of two corpses on a highway today. [https://www.infobae.com/mexico/2024/09/25/cuantos-aliados-del-mayito-flaco-han-muerto-en-la-guerra-dejan-otros-dos-cuerpos-con-sombrero-en-carretera-de-culiacan/ (Infobae)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 South American wildfires]]
**[[2024 Brazil wildfires]]
***Over thirty [[List of environmental organizations|environmental organizations]] condemn [[President of Brazil|Brazilian President]] [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]]'s actions that contradict his calls for further global action against [[climate change]], such as requests for drilling [[oil reserves]] near the [[Amazon River]] and paving the [[BR-319 (Brazil highway)|BR-319 roadway]] through the [[Amazon rainforest|Amazon]] that they state contribute to ongoing wildfires. [https://apnews.com/article/lula-brazil-climate-speech-united-nations-b38f19baa05cce7e5296608f57422208 (AP)]
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Tropical Storm Helene (2024)|Tropical Storm Helene]] forms in the [[Gulf of Mexico]] and is expected to become a major hurricane before making landfall on the [[U.S.]] [[Gulf Coast of the United States|Gulf Coast]] on September 26. [https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/archive/2024/al09/al092024.discus.005.shtml? (National Hurricane Center)]
*[[2024 Pacific hurricane season]]
**Three people are killed in [[flooding]] caused by remnants of [[Hurricane John (2024)|Hurricane John]] in [[Mexico]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/john-weakens-into-tropical-storm-nhc-says-2024-09-24/ (Reuters)]
*The [[USNS Big Horn|USNS ''Big Horn'']] of the [[United States Navy]] [[Ship grounding|runs aground]] and is damaged off the coast of [[Oman]] while operating in the [[Middle East]] after replenishing the [[USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72)|USS ''Abraham Lincoln'']] [[carrier strike group]]. [https://apnews.com/article/us-navy-big-horn-mideast-israel-hamas-war-2e03c24dece6807bac359bf86c5a81dd (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Attempted assassination of Donald Trump in Florida]]
**[[Ryan Wesley Routh]] is formally charged for attempting to assassinate former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] and [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party]] nominee [[Donald Trump]] at [[Trump International Golf Club (West Palm Beach, Florida)|Trump International Golf Club]] in [[West Palm Beach, Florida|West Palm Beach]], [[Florida]], [[United States]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/ryan-routh-arrested-trumps-florida-golf-course-charged-attempted-assas-rcna172571 (NBC News)]
*[[Human rights in Belarus]]
**[[Belarusian people|Belarusian]] independent news outlet ''Reform.news'' reports that [[Jörg Dornau]], an [[Alternative for Germany]] member of the [[Saxony]] [[Landtag of Saxony|parliament]], has allegedly used [[political prisoners]] as labor on a [[Belarus|Belarusian]] [[onion]] [[plantation]] owned by his agricultural firm. [https://www.politico.eu/article/far-right-german-lawmaker-alexander-lukashenko-prisoner-work-belarus-onion-farm-jorg-dornau-afd/ (Politico)]
*[[Murder of Felicia Gayle]]
**Marcellus Williams is executed by the state of [[Missouri]] shortly after the [[Supreme Court of the United States|U.S. Supreme Court]] denies a request to delay the execution. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/marcellus-williams-execution-supreme-court-stay-denied/ (CBS News)]
*[[Recognition of same-sex unions in Thailand]]
**[[Thailand]] passes the marriage equality law allowing [[same-sex couples]] to be [[same-sex marriage|legally wed]] starting in January 2025. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-marriage-equality-law-e0df9fa2d38afc81c53dda81ce489be5 (AP)]
*[[Prosecution of S Iswaran]]
**Former Transport Minister of Singapore [[S Iswaran]] was indicted in court for five (out of 35 known so far) charges for obtaining valuables as a civil servant and one for obstructing the course of justice; decision for his sentencing was adjourned on 3 October. This is the first time since Singapore's independence where a politician has been convicted for such offence.[https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/iswaran-pleads-guilty-amended-charges-opening-trial-4624986 (CNA)] [https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/courts-crime/iswaran-case-from-trial-to-guilty-plea-what-might-have-happened-behind-the-scenes (Straits Times)]

*[[Argentine President]] [[Javier Milei]] proposes an "agenda of freedom" with [[Economic policy|economic]], [[Social policy|social]], and [[Foreign policy|foreign policies]] that directly contradict the [[United Nations]]' "Pact for the Future", which he calls a model to "repress, restrict and curtail" humanity's [[freedom]] and ineffective at preventing conflicts. *[[Harini Amarasuriya]] is appointed the new [[Prime Minister of Sri Lanka]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/sri-lanka-president-dissanayake-picks-harini-amarasuriya-pm-2024-09-24/ (Reuters)]

*Scientists from the [[University of Waterloo]] announce that they have positively identified bones found on [[King William Island]] in [[Nunavut]], [[Canada]], as those of [[James Fitzjames]], captain of {{HMS|Erebus|1826|6}} during [[Franklin's lost expedition]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/north/scientists-identify-frankine-expedition-sailor-1.7332217 (CBC News)]
